🌺 Dreamy Fantasy Princess Gold Floral Arm Cuff– Handmade Beaded Jewelry

Add a touch of magic to your style with this handcrafted butterfly wing arm cuff. Each piece is carefully shaped from durable copper wire and adorned with sparkling crystal beads in shades of pink, yellow, and green. The unique soft feminine godness inspired design wraps gracefully around your arm, making it the perfect statement accessory for prom party, festivals, photoshoots, cosplay, or everyday boho fashion.

💎 Details

Material: Solid aluminium wire + aluminium / copper strands options, premium Czech & Korean crystal glass beads mixed with acrylic beads

Style: Adjustable arm cuff (fits most sizes)

Finish: Bright silver copper with soft pink and green fairycore bead accents

Handmade with love in Jakarta


❣️ Why You'll Love It

– Lightweight yet durable for comfortable wear

– Unique artisanal design, no two cuffs are ever exactly alike

– Complements bohemian, festival, and everyday outfits

– Makes a thoughtful gift for free spirits, travelers, and jewelry lovers


📐 Size :

S : 11 inches
M : 12 inches

The cuffs are adjustable, so you don't need to worry too much about the fit babes 🤗💞. In the photos, I'm wearing Size S (for your preferance I'm 157cm & 54kg weight). Choose what feels best for you! 💕


✨ Material Care
Each arm cuff is carefully handwoven with a sturdy aluminum wire base, with cooper strand for weaving the beads:


Aluminum (main frame) + Copper (strand) → Beautiful warm tone and slightly lower cost, but copper may naturally dull or darken over time.


⚠️ Both aluminum and copper are common jewelry materials, but please note they are not pure gold or stainless steel. Some oxidation is normal to every jewelry material made from l aluminium and copper no matter the seller who sells it. To keep your cuff looking its best, store it in a dry place, avoid prolonged water exposure, and you may apply a thin coat of clear jewelry safe lacquer spray for added protection.


🛠 Care Instructions (Copper & Beads)
Copper naturally develops a patina over time, giving it a vintage look. If you prefer to keep its shine:
1. Store in a dry place, away from moisture and direct sunlight.
2. Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth after wearing.
3. Store it in a soft pouch or jewelry box, away from sunlight and humidity.
4. Do not bend or reshape the wire repeatedly, it could weaken over time.
5. Avoid prolonged contact with water, lotions, and perfumes to preserve the beads and copper finish.

🎁 Perfect For :
– Cosplayer / festival outfits & boho styling
– Renaissance fairs or costumes
– Unique handmade jewelry gifts
– Everyday statement accessory

🧚🏻‍♀️ Please note, due to the delicate handwoven process, slight variations or tiny imperfections may appear, that's part of charm of a truly handcrafted artisan piece making!
